title: PRAISE GOD WITH SONG
MAGNIFY HIM WITH THANKS
end: The Praise Garden — enter His gates with thanksgiving
stock_queries: sunlit forest glade morning light soft mist
misty countryside calm river golden sunrise
calm mountain river glowing warm light
golden sunlight beaming through forest trees
serene lake reflection peaceful countryside morning

scenes.a: If your spirit feels too weary to sing, bring your quiet heart before God right now.
Holy Scripture declares: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
Lord, even when our voices falter, we lift our gratitude to You today.
We thank You for Your unseen faithfulness, Your tender care, and the quiet mercies that sustain us in every trial.
Help us to magnify Your goodness above our deepest fears, turning every sigh into praise and every breath into thanksgiving.
May Your gentle peace guard our minds as we walk step by step in Your grace. Subscribe to join our daily prayer in The Praise Garden.
